profile.headline: Software Engineer at LiveVox
profile.summary:
Full-stack software engineer who is committed to building user-intuitive web applications.

When I’m not in front of the screen, I am in the great outdoors, chipping away at my stack of books, climbing, gardening or hosting dinner parties. My greatest passion is discussing and bringing awareness to mental health issues. My dream is to one day create applications that can bring my knowledge on this topic to help others. Let’s connect and chat!

I enjoy working with but am not limited to:
JavaScript (ES5 & ES6), React, Redux, Node, Express, GraphQL, Apollo, Prisma, RESTful API, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Mongoose, Jest/Enzyme, Mocha/Chai, Git, TDD, AWS, and Firebase.

positions.title: Women's Mentor
positions.description: Mentoring upcoming women in tech in order to help them navigate into a new field. Assisting mentee in clarifying goals and strategies, providing ideas for resources and learning opportunities as well as giving support and encouragement throughout the process.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Teckst has been acquired by LiveVox! We are now working together towards our vision of a robust CRM with heavy focus on curating a seamless Omnichannel experience.

positions.title: Software Engineering Fellow
positions.description: Helping students develop a deeper understanding of vanilla JS, React, MongoDB, MySQL, Express, Node etc. Conducting interviews to screen prospective students. Holding office hours for students who are in need of specific help. Fostering a culture of community and getting students invested in themselves and their peers.
